case_number: CONTEMPT PETITION (CIVIL) No. 624 OF 2020 IN CIVIL APPEAL NO. 5158 OF 2016
summary: Contempt proceedings initiated for wilful disobedience of Supreme Court orders dated 19.08.2020 and 06.05.2021, directing respondents to deposit shortfall amount to maintain USD 60 million in Avitel's Corporation Bank account. Respondents failed to comply, filed repetitive applications on rejected grounds, and allegedly siphoned investment funds. Court found deliberate non-compliance, warranting contempt action.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 9 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
Section 37 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
Article 137 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Contempt petition allowed; respondents held guilty of wilful disobedience and liable for punishment under the Contempt of Courts Act.
